name: voice
title: Voice Transcription
description: Quick, high-quality local voice transcription using Whisper

commands.name: transcribe
commands.title: Transcribe Voice
commands.description: Record and transcribe voice to text

preferences.name: backendDirectory
preferences.title: Backend Directory
preferences.description: Path to the Python backend folder (contains transcription_server.py)

preferences.name: serverPort
preferences.title: Server Port
preferences.description: Port for the local Whisper server

preferences.name: autoStart
preferences.title: Auto-start Recording
preferences.label: Start recording immediately when command opens
preferences.description: When enabled, recording starts automatically. Disable to manually start.

preferences.name: whisperModel
preferences.title: Whisper Model
preferences.description: Model size affects accuracy and speed. Larger = more accurate but slower.

preferences.name: computeDevice
preferences.title: Compute Device
preferences.description: Use CUDA for GPU acceleration (recommended) or CPU as fallback

preferences.name: returnToRoot
preferences.title: Return to Root After Action
preferences.label: Close Raycast after copy or paste
preferences.description: When enabled, finishing actions (Copy/Paste) automatically pop back to the root search.

preferences.name: audioLevelPollingRate
preferences.title: Audio Level Polling Rate (ms)
preferences.description: How often to update audio level indicator (25-250ms). Set to 0 to disable.

preferences.name: autoAction
preferences.title: Auto-action After Transcription
preferences.description: Automatically execute an action when transcription completes. Press Ctrl+A during recording/processing to skip.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
